properties.areaDesc: Young, TX
properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued October 15 at 4:48PM CDT until October 15 at 8:00PM CDT by NWS Fort Worth TX
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Southern Young County in north central Texas...

* WHEN...Until 800 PM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Water over roadways.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 446 PM CDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to slow
moving thunderstorms across southern Young County. Radar
estimates up to 2 inches of rain has fallen in the past hour near
Graham. Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are possible
over the next few hours. Overflowing poor drainage areas will
cause minor flooding in the advisory area.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Graham, Lake Graham, South Bend, Eliasville and Murray.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

NWSheadline: FLOOD ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL 8 PM CDT THIS EVENING

properties.areaDesc: Runnels; Coleman
properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 15 at 4:46PM CDT by NWS San Angelo TX
properties.description:
At 445 PM CDT, Doppler radar was tracking a line of strong
thunderstorms from northwestern Coleman County through southeastern
Runnels County, moving east at 15 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and pea size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Coleman, Ballinger, Santa Anna, Novice, Gouldbusk, Burkett, Glen
Cove, Rockwood, Voss, Silver Valley, Leaday, Rowena, Benoit, Crews,
Valera, Trickham, Talpa, Mozelle, Lake Coleman, and Goldsboro.
properties.instruction: If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

NWSheadline: A LINE OF STRONG THUNDERSTORMS WILL IMPACT COLEMAN AND SOUTHEASTERN RUNNELS COUNTIES THROUGH 545 PM CDT

properties.areaDesc: Eastland
properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 15 at 4:43PM CDT by NWS Fort Worth TX
properties.description:
At 442 PM CDT, Doppler radar was tracking strong thunderstorms along
a line extending from Moran to near Burkett. Movement was east at 20
mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Eastland, Cisco, Rising Star, Lake Cisco, Pleasant Hill, Nimrod,
Sabanno, Morton Valley, Pioneer, and Scranton.

This includes Interstate 20 between mile markers 324 and 343.
properties.instruction: If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

NWSheadline: Strong thunderstorms will impact portions of western Eastland County through 530 PM CDT

properties.areaDesc: Jefferson; Shelby; Spencer
properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 15 at 5:43PM EDT by NWS Louisville KY
properties.description:
At 543 PM EDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm over
Fern Creek, moving east at 30 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and pea size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor damage to outdoor objects is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Jeffersontown, Shelbyville, Middletown, Hollow Creek, Spring Mill,
Fern Creek, Buechel, Highview and Minor Lane Heights.
properties.instruction:
Monitor the weather situation closely and be alert for threatening
weather conditions.

This storm may intensify, so be certain to monitor local radio
stations and available television stations for additional information
and possible warnings from the National Weather Service.

NWSheadline: A STRONG THUNDERSTORM WILL IMPACT NORTHWESTERN SPENCER... NORTHWESTERN SHELBY AND SOUTHEASTERN JEFFERSON COUNTIES UNTIL 615 PM EDT

419 including the City of Clearlake, Middletown, Lower Lake, and
Indian Valley Reservoir, and 420 including Cobb and Mount
Konocti.

* WIND...Sustained winds of 15 to 25mph with gusts to 35 mph
possible in exposed areas.

10- 20% through the morning. Very poor RH recovery into
Friday.

* IMPACTS...any fires that develop will likely spread rapidly.
properties.instruction:

are either occurring now, or will shortly. A combination of
strong winds, low relative humidity, and warm temperatures can
contribute to extreme fire behavior.

properties.areaDesc: Stephens, TX
properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued October 15 at 4:02PM CDT until October 15 at 7:00PM CDT by NWS Fort Worth TX
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Stephens County in north central Texas...

* WHEN...Until 700 PM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Water over roadways.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 401 PM CDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to slow
moving thunderstorms across central and northern Stephens County.
Radar estimates up to 2 inches of rain has fallen in the past
hour southwest of Breckenridge and near Ivan. Additional rainfall
amounts of 1 to 3 inches are possible over the next few hours.
Overflowing poor drainage areas will cause minor flooding in the
advisory area.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Breckenridge, Crystal Falls, Hubbard Creek Reservoir, Lake
Daniel, Caddo, Eolian, Ivan and Eliasville.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.
